mapper.sql: SELECT M.MAP_ID as "mapId", M.DICT_ID as "dictId", M.MAP_TP as "mapTp", M.OLD_NM as "oldNm", M.OLD_ENG_ABRV_NM as "oldEngAbrvNm", M.NEW_ID as "newId", CASE WHEN M.MAP_TP = 'WORD' THEN W.WORD_NM ELSE T.TERMS_NM END as "newNm", CASE WHEN M.MAP_TP = 'WORD' THEN W.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM ELSE T.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM END as "newEngAbrvNm", CASE WHEN M.MAP_TP = 'WORD' THEN W.APRV_YN ELSE T.APRV_YN END as "newAprvYn", M.MAP_REASON as "mapReason", M.USE_YN as "useYn", M.CRET_DT as "cretDt", M.CRET_USER_ID as "cretUserId", M.UPDT_DT as "updtDt", M.UPDT_USER_ID as "updtUserId" FROM TB_STD_MAP M LEFT JOIN TB_WORD W ON M.MAP_TP = 'WORD' AND W.WORD_ID = M.NEW_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TERMS T ON M.MAP_TP = 'TERM' AND T.TERMS_ID = M.NEW_ID

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_WORD WHERE WORD_ID = #{newId} AND DICT_ID = #{dictId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TERMS WHERE TERMS_ID = #{newId} AND DICT_ID = #{dictId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STD_MAP (MAP_ID, DICT_ID, MAP_TP, OLD_NM, OLD_ENG_ABRV_NM, NEW_ID, MAP_REASON, USE_YN, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID) VALUES (#{mapId}, #{dictId}, #{mapTp}, #{oldNm}, NULLIF(#{oldEngAbrvNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), #{newId}, NULLIF(#{mapReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), 'Y', to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_STD_MAP WHERE MAP_ID IN #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT M.OLD_ENG_ABRV_NM as "oldEngAbrvNm", M.OLD_NM as "oldNm", T.TERMS_NM as "newNm", T.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM as "newEngAbrvNm" FROM TB_STD_MAP M JOIN TB_TERMS T ON T.TERMS_ID = M.NEW_ID WHERE M.DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND M.MAP_TP = 'TERM' AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.OLD_ENG_ABRV_NM IS NOT NULL
AND M.OLD_ENG_ABRV_NM IN #{e}
